mapper.select: SELECT s.salon_id, s.owner_id, s.salon_name, s.address, s.phone_number, s.description, s.average_rating, s.image_url, MIN(se.price) AS minimum_price, s.created_at, s.updated_at, s.latitude, s.longitude FROM Salons s LEFT JOIN Services se ON se.salon_id = s.salon_id GROUP BY s.salon_id, s.owner_id, s.salon_name, s.address, s.phone_number, s.description, s.average_rating, s.image_url, s.created_at, s.updated_at ORDER BY s.average_rating DESC, s.salon_id DESC

SELECT s.salon_id, s.owner_id, s.salon_name, s.address, s.phone_number, s.description, s.average_rating, s.image_url, s.latitude, s.longitude, MIN(se.price) AS minimum_price, s.created_at, s.updated_at, u.user_name, closed_at FROM Salons s LEFT JOIN Services se ON se.salon_id = s.salon_id join Users u on u.user_id = s.owner_id WHERE s.salon_id = #{salonId} GROUP BY s.salon_id, s.owner_id, s.salon_name, s.address, s.phone_number, s.description, s.average_rating, s.image_url, s.latitude, s.longitude, s.created_at, s.updated_at, s.closed_at

mapper.insert: insert into Services (salon_id, service_name, category, price, duration_minutes, description, concern) values (#{salonId}, #{serviceName}, #{category}, #{price}, #{durationMinutes}, #{description}, #{concern})
